**Manchester United vs Fulham (Premier League, Old Trafford, scheduled for 16 August 2024; pre-match info only as of 16 August 2024).**[[1]](https://www.manutd.com/en/news/match-preview-for-man-utd-v-fulham-in-the-premier-league-13-august-2024)[[2]](https://www.manutd.com/en/news/early-team-news-for-man-utd-v-fulham-on-16-august-2024)

**Venue and home advantage**: The match is at Old Trafford (Manchester United’s home ground). United benefit from strong home support and familiarity with the pitch/conditions. No notable issues with altitude, climate, or pitch conditions were highlighted in previews. Fulham face a short domestic trip north (roughly 200 miles/3–4 hours by road or train from London), with minimal expected fatigue impact for a season opener.[[1]](https://www.manutd.com/en/news/match-preview-for-man-utd-v-fulham-in-the-premier-league-13-august-2024)

**Head-to-head history**: Manchester United have a dominant record overall against Fulham across competitive fixtures (historically winning the large majority of meetings, e.g., around 58 wins in 94 meetings in some tallies). In the Premier League specifically, United have a strong recent edge, winning 7, drawing 2, and losing 1 of their last 10 league meetings. Notable prior results (pre-August 2024) include a 1-2 loss for United at Old Trafford in February 2024 and other close contests. No major tournament (e.g., cup) specifics stood out beyond standard league encounters in available previews.[[3]](https://www.statmuse.com/fc/ask/man-united-last-10-games-vs-fulham)[[4]](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/man-utd/head-to-head/man-utd-vs-fulham-head-to-head-record-and-past-meetings_550315.html)

**Recent form/results (pre-August 2024)**: United entered the 2024/25 season after finishing 8th in 2023/24 (their lowest-ever Premier League placing at the time). Fulham had a solid mid-table campaign in 2023/24. Specific pre-season or immediate prior form details were limited in early previews, with focus shifting to the new campaign opener.[[5]](https://www.premierleague.com/en/match/2444470/manchester-united-fulham)

**Injuries and suspensions**: 
- Manchester United had several concerns: Leny Yoro (ankle/foot injury; underwent successful surgery on 5 August 2024 and ruled out); reports also referenced issues or absences involving players like Rasmus Højlund (ankle), Victor Lindelöf (muscle), Tyrell Malacia (knee), Luke Shaw (health problems), and others. No major suspensions noted for the squad in pre-match updates.[[1]](https://www.manutd.com/en/news/match-preview-for-man-utd-v-fulham-in-the-premier-league-13-august-2024)[[6]](https://www.scribd.com/document/937418611/MNU-FUL-Manchester-Utd-Fulham-Lineups)
- Fulham reported no injury concerns ahead of the fixture.[[2]](https://www.manutd.com/en/news/early-team-news-for-man-utd-v-fulham-on-16-august-2024)

**Other storylines and factors**: This was the opening match of the 2024/25 Premier League season (Matchweek 1). Key narratives included Erik ten Hag’s United aiming to bounce back after the prior season’s struggles, with new signing Joshua Zirkzee (recently arrived from Bologna) potentially featuring despite limited pre-season minutes due to international commitments. Bruno Fernandes was noted in some tactical discussions. Fulham, under Marco Silva, were viewed as a resilient side capable of causing problems on the counter. No other major external factors (e.g., weather extremes, crowd issues, or off-field controversies) were prominently flagged in available pre-match coverage.[[1]](https://www.manutd.com/en/news/match-preview-for-man-utd-v-fulham-in-the-premier-league-13-august-2024)[[5]](https://www.premierleague.com/en/match/2444470/manchester-united-fulham)

All details above are drawn exclusively from sources and publications dated on or before 16 August 2024 (or referring to events/information known by then). Actual match outcomes or any post-16 August 2024 events have been disregarded.

factors.impact: Positive for Man United due to playing at Old Trafford with strong home support and familiarity.
Strongly favors Man United, who have a dominant record overall and won 7 of their last 10 Premier League meetings against Fulham.

Significant negative for Man United. Key players like Leny Yoro, Rasmus Højlund, Victor Lindelöf, Tyrell Malacia, and Luke Shaw are noted with injuries or absences, severely impacting squad depth and starting quality for the season opener.
Positive for Fulham, as they report no injury concerns, allowing them to field a full-strength squad.
Negative for Man United, as they finished 8th, their lowest-ever Premier League placing, indicating a period of struggle leading into this season.

factors.factor: Recent Fulham Victory at Old Trafford
factors.impact: Slight negative for Man United's perceived dominance at home, given Fulham secured a 2-1 win at Old Trafford in February 2024.

analysis.reasoning: While Manchester United benefits from playing at home at Old Trafford and boasts a strong historical head-to-head record against Fulham, these advantages are significantly tempered by several critical factors. United ended the previous season in their lowest-ever Premier League position (8th), suggesting a team in need of recovery. More importantly, they enter the new season with a substantial injury crisis, listing multiple key players (including a new signing and established starters) as sidelined or doubtful. In contrast, Fulham reports no injury concerns, ensuring they can field a full-strength squad. Furthermore, Fulham has demonstrated their capability to upset United at Old Trafford, having secured a 2-1 victory there in February 2024. The cumulative impact of United's recent struggles and a debilitating injury list significantly weakens their position, warranting a negative adjustment to their predicted performance, despite remaining the generally favored team.
